title: Web Development
desc: Build responsive, high-performance React applications using modular architecture and optimized components.
shortDesc: Build fast and responsive React-based applications with reusable components, clean architecture, and full responsiveness across devices.
desc1: I create modern web applications with React, ensuring code reusability, clarity, and performance. My focus is on building scalable frontend solutions.
desc2: I work with technologies like React, Redux Toolkit, and Webpack to deliver efficient and maintainable code tailored to your product’s needs.

process.title: Development Process
process.desc: From planning and prototyping to deployment, I follow best practices and modern workflows for web development.

title: UI/UX Implementation
desc: Turn design mockups into responsive, accessible, and maintainable user interfaces.
shortDesc: Convert Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive UI with attention to accessibility, usability, and clean CSS/Styled Components.
desc1: I work closely with design systems and tools like Figma to translate mockups into high-quality frontend implementations.
desc2: Special attention is given to layout precision, accessibility (ARIA), and responsive behavior across devices.

process.title: Design to Code Workflow
process.desc: Bringing designs to life with CSS modules, styled-components, and utility frameworks.

title: API Integration
desc: Seamlessly connect frontend to backend services using modern data-fetching techniques.
shortDesc: Connect frontend with RESTful APIs using Axios or RTK Query, handle loading states, errors, and dynamic data with Redux Toolkit.
desc1: I manage API calls with tools like RTK Query and Axios, ensuring robust data fetching, caching, and error handling.
desc2: I implement loading states, notifications, and fallback UI for seamless user experience and maintainable code.

process.title: Integration Pipeline
process.desc: Reliable data integration for modern SPAs, focused on clean state management and maintainability.

title: Component Libraries
desc: Accelerate development with reusable UI libraries, customized for your product’s design.
shortDesc: Use and customize UI libraries like Material UI or Tailwind to speed up development while keeping the design clean and consistent.
desc1: I integrate and style libraries such as Material UI, Ant Design, and Tailwind CSS to maintain visual consistency and speed up development.
desc2: Each component is built to be flexible, reusable, and aligned with your brand's design system.

process.title: Library Integration Flow
process.desc: From setup to fine-tuning, I ensure every library fits your UI needs while keeping performance optimal.
